title: Figure 8: Object Sightings by Sighting Reliability Group with Evaluation Distributions
description: A central pie chart divides 2199 object sightings into four reliability groups: Excellent (213 = 9.7%), Good (757 = 34.5%), Doubtful (794 = 36.0%) and Poor (435 = 19.8%). Dashed lines connect each group to its own pie chart showing evaluation categories (Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown); for example, Unknown is 71 = 33.3% in the Excellent group. Caption: "FIGURE 8 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY SIGHTING RELIABILITY GROUPS WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTIONS FOR EACH GROUP"; drawing A-7486, page 24.
